verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no option to return semantically chunked output. It offers markdown output (return_page_markdown) and AI or CSS-based field extraction (ai_query, ai_extract_rules, extract_rules). These are adjacent output-format and extraction features: they still return one page blob or targeted fields, not retrieval-ready chunks. Chunking is a fair axis for a scraping API aimed at AI users, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can request semantically chunked output instead of one large content blob, so it feeds cleanly into a retrieval pipeline
